lines.en: I walk slowly, and the ground shakes.
Each step presses a shallow crater.
I keep my head low, not watching the path.
Ki spills out from behind me.

lines.zh: 石砖在我脚下碎成粉末。
lines.en: The stone tiles crumble to powder under my feet.
I lift a foot, dust flees first.
My shoulder knocks branches aside.

lines.zh: 布罗利的脚步压得地面下沉。
lines.en: Broly's steps press the ground down.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声比脚步更响。
lines.en: My breathing is louder than my steps.

lines.zh: 空气在我身边变得沉重。
lines.en: The air grows heavy around me.
Grass lies flat where I step.

lines.zh: 我一步步走向那个声音。
lines.en: I walk step by step toward that sound.
I clutch my head, holding something back.
Ki writhes beneath my skin.
My fists clench on their own.
I lift my head, then let it fall.
A word keeps ringing in my skull.
I try to pull my ki back in.
My chest feels tight and burning.
I'm holding back, and it's hard.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把脑子里的话甩开。
lines.en: I shake my head to throw off the words.
This quiet bothers me.
I breathe out a plume of white.
My muscles tighten like stone.

lines.zh: 我记得一些不太好的事。
lines.en: I remember some unpleasant things.

lines.zh: 再等一下，我就压不住了。
lines.en: A moment more and I can't hold it.
You... calling me?

lines.zh: 退到十步外，对我好，也对你好。
lines.en: Stay ten paces back; it's better for both of us.
I can smell your ki.
I know that look. Mockery.
You want a fight? I'll oblige.
My head hurts badly.
Why are you staring at me?

lines.zh: 我不是坏人，可我控制不住。
lines.en: I'm not cruel, but I can't control it.
Your voice is too loud.
Get back. Now.
Your heart is racing.
Don't raise your hands.
I'll try not to strike.
Your ki is very weak.
Why do you force me?
Don't say my name; keep your distance.
Your footsteps grate on me.
I... remember now.
It hurts, but it isn't the worst.
Stop, I'll lose control.
My ki is in disarray.
Your hand is shaking, isn't it?

lines.zh: 这一下让我清醒了一点。
lines.en: That cleared my head a little.
I stepped back because I chose not to fight.
Don't force me to transform.
I grit my teeth and endure.
The taste of blood is familiar.
I'm still standing.
What's that? Can I eat it?
I'm hungry, but I shouldn't eat.
The smell distracts me.
Put it down and walk away.

lines.zh: 这口热的，让我想起从前。
lines.en: This warm bite reminds me of before.
Don't wave it in front of me.
This reminds me of something else.
I might bite you along with it.
I don't need your kindness.
Take it away, while I'm still clear-headed.
Don't touch me, you'll break.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，还没变身就够大。
lines.en: This body is huge before I even transform.
Hit me and you bounce back.
My shoulder is like a block of iron.
Back off, I don't want to hurt you.

lines.zh: 气把我身边的空气推开了。
lines.en: My aura shoves the air aside.
Your things hit the ground.
I turn and hit a tree.
That little bump annoys me more.
Three steps away is enough.
I don't understand this.
Stay away from me, you'll get hurt.
It's too loud inside my head.
I'm no good at such things.
I can't even control myself.
Go, and don't look back.
My past is no place for you.
I fear I'll lose control.
Be quiet, I need quiet.
Don't take me for someone else.
I pick it up and crush it.
Too strong, it broke.
Whose is this?
I shove it into my waistband.
It trembles in my grip.
I sniff it, nothing.
I don't want to take others' things.
That glint on the ground is harsh.

lines.zh: 我捏着它，轻轻放回你手上。
lines.en: I pinch it lightly and set it back in your hand.
You dropped this, hold it.
You forced this.
I can't hold my ki back anymore.
Don't stand in front of me.
I heard that word.
I need to let this out.
You're the target now, sorry.
My sight is going white.
Don't run, it excites me more.
Smash you, and the pain stops.
I'll try to strike only once.
Your face reminds me of him.
Back off, last warning.
The ki is full to bursting.
I can't control it.
I'm sorry.
My ki blast is already in hand.
You look like a target to me.
I bite down, keep quiet.
Ki is leaking out now.
My fists are burning hot.
I remember your position.
I'm not good at chasing.
The ground is sinking.
Retreating won't help you.
I hear your bones creak.
It'll be over soon.
I don't want to see your face.
The ki blast is ready.
This one will be big.
Don't shout my name.

lines.zh: 气在皮肤下顶，我快压不住。
lines.en: Ki pushes under my skin; I can barely hold it.
Counted to two already.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，可这不是怕。
lines.en: My hand is shaking, but not from fear.
It ends here.
One punch, straight into the ground.
My punch's wind lifts the soil.
You're sent flying.
I didn't hold back there.
My fist is still burning.
Combo, one after another.
My ki blast is quicker than you.
Sorry. Truly sorry.

lines.zh: 我的拳风把你推到墙上。
lines.en: The shockwave of my fist slams you into the wall.

lines.zh: 我一拳，你的甲片凹成坑。
lines.en: One punch leaves a crater in your armor plate.
My fist hits the ground, it splits.
I'm not even trying.

lines.zh: 我这一拳从你护腕上碾过去。
lines.en: My fist grinds straight through your bracer.
You fly and snap a tree.
This blow is to end it.
Get up and go, quickly.
Where I came from, I don't recall.
Ki arrives first, then I land.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半片地。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the ground.
A patch of ground sinks.
I lift my head, eyes bright.
All sounds around me shrink.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，不知道为何。
lines.en: I stand here, not knowing why.
My breathing is coarse.
Dirt and stones are still falling.
Someone has let me out.

lines.zh: 气一聚起来，地就往下陷。
lines.en: When my ki gathers, the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 胸口那团火又烧起来了。
lines.en: That fire in my chest burns again.
I raise a hand against the sun.
This land is unfamiliar.
Don't be afraid, I'll try not to fight.
Ki spins into a vortex around me.
When I land, the world goes quiet.
I... woke up again.
Fire bakes me, I don't flinch.
I fall and leave a crater.
Underwater, my ki is smothered.
The blast leaves my ears ringing.
An arrow sticks in my back.
This power is pressing down my ki.
Empty belly, weaker ki.
Lightning strikes and my whole body jerks.
In the void, ki slips away.
